# Business case — Falcon Gulf Ops Recovery

*Generated by `python -m falcon.evaluation` from `docs/evaluation.json`. Every figure below is **quantity from the evaluation × an editable assumption**. The assumptions are demo values for a fictional airline: replace them with real ones in the dashboard (Business case tab) or in `falcon/business_case.py`.*

## Headline (default assumptions)

- **AED 197,771 saved on one disrupted day** — airline AED 188,471, ground handler AED 9,300.
- **59 staff hours saved that day** (rebooking agents 48 → 1.3 h, controllers 12.1 → 0.6 h).
- **AED 13,052,864 gross per year** over 66 disrupted-day equivalents; **AED 11,552,864 net** after running costs.
- **Payback 3.1 months**, three-year ROI 1055%.

## Assumptions (all editable)

| Group | Assumption | Value | Unit | Note |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Airline | Cost of one aircraft delay minute | 380 | AED/min | blended narrow/wide-body: crew, fuel burn, maintenance, lost utilisation |
| Airline | Cost of one missed connection | 950 | AED/pax | rebooking, compensation exposure, lost goodwill |
| Airline | Care for one passenger stranded overnight | 620 | AED/pax | hotel, meals, transfers |
| Airline | Cost of one misconnected bag | 380 | AED/bag | courier delivery, handling, claims |
| Airline | Customer-service agent, fully loaded | 85 | AED/h |  |
| Airline | Operations controller, fully loaded | 160 | AED/h |  |
| Airline | Controller time to review and answer one approval request | 3 | min | with the trade-off and data already on screen |
| Airline | Staff time to handle one escalation from the system | 10 | min |  |
| Ground handler | SLA penalty per departure more than 15 min late | 2,500 | AED/flight | share attributable to the turnaround |
| Ground handler | Overtime and idle equipment per hub departure delay minute | 45 | AED/min | teams and equipment held on a late stand |
| Ground handler | Cost of extra teams dispatched by the system (multiplier) | 1 | x | 1.0 = the per-dispatch costs in config.GROUND_MEASURES |
| Scale | Days per year like the replayed day | 40 | days | sandstorm, fog, ATC, strikes |
| Scale | Ordinary operating days per year | 325 | days |  |
| Scale | Benefit on an ordinary day as a share of a disrupted day | 0.08 | share | everyday late inbounds and tight connections |
| Investment | Platform, support, integrations and LLM usage per year | 1.5e+06 | AED/yr |  |
| Investment | One-off implementation and integration | 3e+06 | AED |  |

## Read this before quoting the numbers

- The quantities come from **one seeded, simulated day**; the prices are **placeholders**. The model's value is its structure: change any assumption and every figure updates.
- The ground handler pays for the extra teams the system dispatches but gains more from fewer SLA penalties and less overtime; whether that split is fair is a contract question, shown here so it can be discussed.
- Not counted: revenue protected by better punctuality, crew overtime, fuel from fewer holds in the air, and the cost of the human approvers' attention beyond the review minutes above.
